notes.title: Season 6 is now live! + Better odds
notes.content:
A new season has arrived! We've replaced the current drop pool with the Season 6 drop pool featuring Misora, Amatsuki, Kouten, Teno, and Tenki. A brand new Season Case (#6) has been added to the Idling mode drop pool, along with a new Backgrounds Case including backgrounds from Seasons 1–5. Players can now open up to 100 cases at once, and customize resolution in Settings (480x480, 960x960, 1080x1080). We’ve also adjusted drop rates across Idling and Clicker mode, as well as Case opening — making Legendary items twice as likely to drop.

- Replaced current drop pool with Season 6 drop pool

- New Season case added into Idling drop pool

- Players can now adjust the resolution in Settings (480x480, 960x960, 1080x1080)
- Players can now open multiple cases at once, up to 100 cases simultaneously
- Fixed bug in Idling mode

notes.title: Season 5 is now live! + Idling mode
notes.content:
We are glad to announce a big update to our game with some new features and bug fixes!

Anytime the game is running players can now switch between Clicker and Idling modes.
Clicker Mode
In this mode, players are rewarded items for clicking on the “Cookie”. The reward is distributed once every 30 minutes, and is based on 1 click on the image in the specific time window.
The drop pool of Clicker mode always consists of the current Season’s items.

Idling Mode
In this mode, players are rewarded items for Idling inside the game. The reward is distributed once every 30 minutes automatically, without the need of clicking the Cookie.
The drop pool of Idling mode consists of various new cases:
Backgrounds Case - Colors
Season Case (#1)
Season Case (#2)
Season Case (#3)
Season Case (#4)
Season Case (#5)
The odds for opening a case are the same as the in-game drops.

Backgrounds
Players can now choose backgrounds from their inventory and set them active (same as the cookies).

- Replaced current drop pool with Season 5 drop pool
- Current drop pool: Izumi, Rin, Yuna, Emi, Sakura
- Added a drop timer
- Introduced Clicker and Idle mode
- Introduced Cases
- Introduced Backgrounds
- Added filtering options in Inventory
- Added drop logging
- Added sensitivity settings for scrolling in Inventory
- Fixed bugs in Inventory UI
- Fixed graphical bugs
